summary: The root أني (Any) is cross-referenced to the root أنى (Anā). To understand its meaning, one should consult the definitions provided under the root أنى.
lane: إِنِيهْ أنيه إناء انيه انية ونى آني آنيه آنية : see art. انى .

headwords.def: آنٍ آن Hot, or heated, to the utmost degree: applied to hot water, (S, M, K,) in the Kur lv. 44: (S, M:) fem. آنِيَةٌ ; occurring in the Kur lxxxviii. 5. M.) See also أَنِىٌّ . Also A man much characterized by moderation, gentleness, or deliberateness; by a leisurely manner of proceeding, or of deportment, &c.; by patience, as meaning contr. of hastiness; by gravity, staidness, sedateness, or calmness. (S, K. *)

headwords.def: أَتَيْتُهُ آنِيَةً بَعْدَ آنِيَةٍ is a phrase mentioned by AAF, meaning I came to him time after time: in which, [says ISd,] I am of opinion that آنية is of the measure فَاعِلَةٌ from الإنَى : but the word commonly known is آوِنَة [pl. of أَوَانٌ ; or آيِنَة , which is syn. with آوِنَة : see أَوَانٌ ].
